briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Brands Push Outward as D.C. Clears a Path for Psychedelics and Rescheduling
briefs.top: Michigan operators are finding growth outside the state's tax squeeze — JARS is now Arizona's biggest chain and a national gummy brand just landed on local shelves — while both gubernatorial campaigns face real pressure to roll back the 24% wholesale tax. Nationally, momentum keeps building: a federal court just upheld medical marijuana's move to Schedule III, the FDA is actively shaping a psychedelics approval pathway, and Compass Pathways is racing toward a possible 2027 psilocybin launch.

local.text: Troy-based JARS becomes Arizona's largest dispensary chain
local.detail: JARS Cannabis, the Michigan chain, announced a deal to acquire Sonoran Roots and its eight Ponderosa dispensaries, making it Arizona's biggest retailer.
local.text_full: Troy-based JARS becomes Arizona's largest dispensary chain — JARS Cannabis, the Michigan chain, announced a deal to acquire Sonoran Roots and its eight Ponderosa dispensaries, making it Arizona's biggest retailer.

local.text: Grön's bestselling gummies hit Michigan shelves
local.detail: Wyld-owned edibles brand Grön rolled its 'Pearls' gummies into Pure Options, High Profile and Lume as part of a four-state expansion.
local.text_full: Grön's bestselling gummies hit Michigan shelves — Wyld-owned edibles brand Grön rolled its 'Pearls' gummies into Pure Options, High Profile and Lume as part of a four-state expansion.

local.text: Common Citizen locks in new Eastpointe storefront
local.detail: A court-approved deal gives Common Citizen until Dec. 1 to finish buildout and open its newest dispensary in Eastpointe.
local.text_full: Common Citizen locks in new Eastpointe storefront — A court-approved deal gives Common Citizen until Dec. 1 to finish buildout and open its newest dispensary in Eastpointe.

local.text: GOP nominee's tax-repeal pledge wins industry's backing
local.detail: MiCIA formally endorsed Republican John James over his vow to kill the 24% wholesale tax, calling him 'the clear choice for the cannabis industry.'
local.text_full: GOP nominee's tax-repeal pledge wins industry's backing — MiCIA formally endorsed Republican John James over his vow to kill the 24% wholesale tax, calling him 'the clear choice for the cannabis industry.'

local.text: Wholesale tax badly missing revenue targets, fueling repeal push
local.detail: The 24% levy brought in only about $37 million in Q2 versus a projected $105 million per quarter, ammunition both campaigns are now using to argue for rollback.
local.text_full: Wholesale tax badly missing revenue targets, fueling repeal push — The 24% levy brought in only about $37 million in Q2 versus a projected $105 million per quarter, ammunition both campaigns are now using to argue for rollback.

national.text: FDA hearing signals real path for psilocybin, methylone
national.detail: FDA officials told a White Oak hearing there's 'growing interest and active research' on psychedelics for serious mental health conditions, weighing rules for future approved use.
national.text_full: FDA hearing signals real path for psilocybin, methylone — FDA officials told a White Oak hearing there's 'growing interest and active research' on psychedelics for serious mental health conditions, weighing rules for future approved use.

national.text: Compass Pathways targets first-half 2027 psilocybin launch
national.detail: Compass is submitting a rolling NDA for COMP360, boosted by a National Priority Voucher that could cut FDA review time to just 1-2 months.
national.text_full: Compass Pathways targets first-half 2027 psilocybin launch — Compass is submitting a rolling NDA for COMP360, boosted by a National Priority Voucher that could cut FDA review time to just 1-2 months.

national.text: Federal court rejects bid to block marijuana's Schedule III move
national.detail: The D.C. Circuit left the medical marijuana rescheduling order in effect, ruling opponents hadn't proven their case.

national.text: Congress buys hemp industry a one-month reprieve
national.detail: Trump signed a bill pushing the federal hemp THC ban from Nov. 12 to Dec. 11, giving Congress more time to write guardrails instead of an outright ban.

national.text: MSO consolidation deals keep landing despite tight margins
national.detail: Cannabist's court-supervised exits, including its Ohio and Delaware operations, are setting fresh distressed-asset benchmarks as buyers like Holistic Industries move in.
